Package io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.client

Class WorkflowEngineClient

java.lang.Object
io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.client.WorkflowEngineClient
public class WorkflowEngineClient extends Object
The primary client for hosting workflow engine handlers.

Register handlers with the fluent eventProcessor(java.lang.String, io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.app.EventProcessorDef), transactionHandler(java.lang.String, io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.app.TransactionHandlerRegistration) and eventSource(io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.handlers.EventSource) methods (or the low-level registerX methods), then call start() to connect. Handler setup hooks run according to the configured SetupLifecycle.

    • start

      public void start() throws Exception
      Connect to the workflow engine and register handlers. With SetupLifecycle.BOOT (default), setup() hooks also run here, after the connect — so that hosted ws-proxy bindings have an established WebSocket before setup() tries to call platform services. With SetupLifecycle.DEFERRED, hooks do NOT run here; they run when the proxy dispatches a SETUP_TRIGGER_REQUEST (issued by service-manager as part of the deploy operation, carrying the deployer's authRef so hosted-binding calls inside setup() authenticate as the deploying user).
      Throws:
      Exception
